newsitem.title: CHINA: China exchange bans member for illegal trading.
newsitem.headline: China exchange bans member for illegal trading.

text.p: China's Zhengzhou Commodity Exchange has banned a member firm and an individual investor from trading for manipulating green bean futures prices, the Shanghai Securities News said on Wednesday.

The newspaper said the company, identified as Henan Dulai Duqu Dushu She, tried to rig the prices of green bean futures in late 1996 by holding positions in excess of exchange limits or by registering positions in different customer names.
It quoted an exchange circular as saying the firm managed to push the price of the January 1997 grean bean futures contracts to limit-down on December 27, the circular said.
"Its malicious stir-frying (speculation) disturbed normal trading on the exchange," the circular said.

The retail investor banned from trading, identified as Deng Wei, tried to manipulate prices in futures trading on the Zhengzhou exchange from July to December last year by opening large positions using false names, it said.

In a sweeping crackdown on the country's commodity futures markets last year, Beijing ordered all of the exchanges to strengthen registration rules for members and investors, and to permanently ban serious violaters.
